svg.title: Complete WiSensing RX5 INT8 Pose CNN architecture
svg.text: Full layer flow · feature-map illustrations · INT8 FPGA inference · 12-joint coordinate regression
Total input [15, 128, 10] → gather base / delta / mask for each RX → apply the same trained encoder weights.
Five receiver outputs are concatenated along channels; values are then flattened in RX → C → S → T order.
BatchNorm is folded into Conv weights/bias. Dropout is omitted during inference. All FC layers include Requant; FC3 has no GELU.
Blocks and neuron counts are schematic; labels show actual tensor sizes. Source: pl/cnn/README.md · pl/cnn/rtl/FC/fc_top.v
